motivation: H3 v1 (15m, range, 9 stacked conditions, limit retest) produced 5 candidates in 6 months. H3B keeps the mechanism (two comparable extremes + RSI divergence + neckline break) but aligns it with the 4h trend (the only context the project has shown to add value: M1/M3 replay, S107 long-in-up-regime), moves it to 1h, enters at market on the confirmed break and uses structural stops wide enough for costs to stay ~0.1-0.2R.
relation_to_h3_v1: New id. Not a threshold search on v1: different timeframe, context (with-trend instead of range), entry and exits. Data overlap with v1 (8 of the 10 symbols, 2025-08..2026-09) is acknowledged; v1 produced 5 candidates, so information leakage is negligible.
scan: every closed 1h bar, closed bars only

setup_long.trend_4h: last closed 4h close > EMA50(4h) and EMA20(4h) > EMA50(4h)
setup_long.pivots: 1h pivot lows of width 3 (confirmed 3 bars later)
setup_long.pair: latest confirmed pivot low p2 and an earlier pivot low p1 with 5 <= p2-p1 <= 60 bars
setup_long.divergence: RSI14(1h) at p2 >= RSI14 at p1 + 2
setup_long.neckline: highest high strictly between p1 and p2; neckline - max(low p1, low p2) >= 1.0 x ATR14
setup_long.trigger: the current closed 1h bar is the first close above the neckline after p2, within 24 bars of p2
setup_long.short: mirror image: pivot highs, 4h downtrend, bearish divergence, close below neckline

execution.entry: market at the first 1m close after the 1h bar closes (+3 min arm latency, live shadow convention)
execution.stop: min(low p1, low p2) - 0.25 x ATR14(1h) (mirror for shorts)
execution.risk_filter: stop distance 1.0%-6.0% of entry reference, else no trade
execution.costs: live shadow model: taker 5 bps, target maker 2 bps, market slippage 5 bps (base) and 10 bps (stress)

gates_stress_all_required_for_a_policy: mean net R per filled trade > 0 with day-block bootstrap one-sided 98.3% lower bound > 0 (Bonferroni for 3 policies)
total R > 0 in each of 2024, 2025 and 2026
no single symbol contributes > 40% of gross profit
decision_meaning: PASS authorizes shadow + paper-forward only; live stays disabled
no_parameter_search: exactly one configuration; any change requires a new id
